name: Data-Tel of Louisiana
old_description: Welcome to Data-Tel of Louisiana, Inc. (Data-Tel) where our business is “connecting your world”. Data-Tel is a corporation registered in the state of Louisiana and operates under Louisiana Contractor License #36386. We are also licensed in the states of Mississippi and Alabama. With a staff of over twenty employees, and an in-house Registered Communication Distribution Designer (RCDD), Data-Tel of Louisiana specializes in structured cabling systems, low voltage systems wiring, outside plant fiber optic and copper design and installation.
about:
Data-Tel of Louisiana, Inc. was established in Walker, Louisiana, by Emily LeBlanc and Bart LeBlanc. The woman-owned, family-operated business has served the Gulf Coast region for over two decades. The company holds a Louisiana Contractor License (#36386) and is also licensed in Mississippi and Alabama.

Data-Tel designs and installs structured cabling systems, low-voltage wiring, and outside-plant fiber optic and copper infrastructure. With a staff of 12 to 22 employees and an in-house Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD), the firm handles design, project management, installation, and maintenance. It installs roughly 1.4 million feet of cable annually and owns cable testers and fiber fusion splicers for on-demand troubleshooting and emergency repairs.

The company serves commercial retail, government, medical, education, financial, and new-construction/renovation markets. Notable projects include the 8th Air Force War Command Center at Barksdale AFB, Louisiana Heart Hospital, North Oaks renovations, New Orleans Convention Center renovations, Broadmoor Elementary School, and wireless infrastructure deployments for East Baton Rouge, Rapides, and St. Tammany parishes.

Data-Tel differentiates itself by completing most wiring conversions overnight to minimize client downtime, offering 24/7 technician response, and providing manufacturer-backed warranties that can extend beyond 25 years. Its technicians maintain BICSI certifications and participate in ongoing manufacturer training, ensuring installations support speeds up to 40 Gbps.
